# ResumeScore

> Transparent, evidence-based resume scoring, job match intelligence, and ATS readability analysis with private, browser-only deterministic computation.

## Core Capabilities
- **Deterministic 7-Pillar Scoring**: Objective, repeatable evaluation across Contact Completeness, Section Structure, Impact Quantification, Action Verb Strength, Repetition Avoidance, Brevity & Formatting, and Job Terminology Alignment.
- **Job Description Match Intelligence**: Layered semantic skill extraction, identifying demonstrated, mentioned, transferable, and missing skills against job requirements.
- **Anti-Hallucination Bullet Improvements**: Evidence-grounded suggested revisions that improve clarity and action verbs without fabricating achievements, employers, or skills.
- **Privacy-by-Default Architecture**: Client-side document parsing (PDF, DOCX, TXT) and scoring execute completely inside the user's browser. Zero cloud resume storage and no required user accounts.
- **Multi-Format Export**: In-browser resume editor with live comparison and direct export to DOCX, TXT, and selectable PDF.

## Web Application Routes
- Main Platform: https://resumescore-phi.vercel.app/
- Resume Analyzer & Job Match: https://resumescore-phi.vercel.app/analyze
- Privacy Policy & Data Architecture: https://resumescore-phi.vercel.app/privacy
- Local History Dashboard: https://resumescore-phi.vercel.app/history (browser-local storage only)

## Technical Architecture
- Framework: Next.js 16 (App Router) with React 19 and Tailwind CSS
- Client Parsing: pdfjs-dist and zip.js for client-side document extraction
- External AI Status: Paid external AI is strictly locked and disabled in production; all core scoring uses deterministic algorithmic rubrics.
- Open Source Repository: https://github.com/skmdshariff143-ai/resumescore
